placet.title: Placet Group — Mobile Application
placet.description: Complete mobile app redesign with focus on clarity, control, and trust. Rebuilt user scenario architecture, financial states, and card journey.
placet.listDescription: Mobile app redesign focused on clear financial states and next best actions across loans, credit line, and card scenarios.
placet.challenge:
Users of the mobile application experienced high cognitive load when managing financial products. Key states — available balance, debt, limits, and next actions — were scattered across different screens and flows.
As a result, users often lacked a clear understanding of their current financial state and hesitated when making decisions.
placet.solution:
I redesigned the mobile application structure with a focus on transparent financial states and clear next actions.
Key product decisions included:
• a unified overview of essential financial indicators,
• clear separation of products (loans, credit line, cards),
• prioritization of the next logical action for the user,
• consistent UX patterns and navigation across scenarios.
placet.result: The updated application structure reduced cognitive load and simplified decision-making. Users gained faster clarity about their financial state, contacted support less frequently, and interacted more confidently with key app features.

impact.label: On-time payments +22%
impact.description: Clear financial states. Fewer errors and missed actions.

impact.label: Support requests −26%
impact.description: Transparent balances and statuses. Less confusion, fewer questions.

impact.label: Financial clarity ×2
impact.description: Key information is visible instantly. Decisions are made faster.

screen1.title: Authentication & Face ID onboarding
screen1.description: A unified overview screen allows users to instantly understand their current financial state: balance, debt, and active products. The main focus is fast clarity without navigating between multiple sections.

screen2.title: Dashboard — credit line at a glance
screen2.description: Loans, credit line, and cards were clearly separated at both structural and navigation levels. This removed scenario overlap and helped users navigate available products more efficiently.

screen3.title: Financial states — processing, active and overdue
screen3.description: For each product, a clear next best action was defined. The interface guides users toward the most relevant step based on their current state and context.

screen4.title: Card ordering and delivery timeline
screen4.description: The transaction history was redesigned with a focus on readability and hierarchy. Users can quickly understand what happened, when it occurred, and how it affects their financial state.

screen5.title: Black Card controls and safety tools
screen5.description: UX patterns were unified across all scenarios. This reduced the learning curve and enabled more confident interaction with the application.

screen6.title: Visual system — dark & light explorations
screen6.description: The application structure was designed with scalability in mind. New products and features can be added without breaking existing user flows.

paskolos.title: Paskolos.lt — Credit Line
paskolos.description: Credit line product design with emphasis on transparency of terms and informed decision-making.
paskolos.listDescription: Credit line product design focused on transparent terms, limit management, and confident user decision-making.
paskolos.challenge:
At the product entry point, users struggled to quickly understand the difference between a credit line and a consumer loan, as well as determine which option suited their needs.
Fragmented offers and conditions turned the selection process into guesswork, reducing trust before the application even began.
paskolos.solution:
I separated the two products at both structural and scenario levels, creating clear entry points for the credit line and consumer loan.
Key decisions included:
• dedicated hero sections with clear offers for each product,
• visual and textual explanation of product differences,
• a simplified three-step flow for consumer loan applications,
• using the calculator and limit selection as the primary entry point for the credit line.
paskolos.result:
The product structure became clear from the very first screen. Users selected the appropriate scenario faster, better understood the terms, and moved to application with greater confidence.
Trust increased through clear offers and a logical user journey.

impact.label: Application conversion +18%
impact.description: Separated Credit Line vs Consumer Loan — users pick the right path faster and proceed with confidence.

impact.label: Step-1 drop-offs −32%
impact.description: Made terms and calculator visible before the flow — less uncertainty, fewer exits, higher trust.

impact.label: Product choice 2.1× faster
impact.description: Differences are obvious at a glance — decisions happen without extra comparison loops.

screen4.title: Credit line landing (Desktop)

screen7.title: Consumer loan (Mobile)

screen8.title: Credit line (Mobile)
screen8.description: The final step — application submission — is integrated into the self-service environment. Users complete the process in a familiar context without feeling a disconnected flow.

placetSelfservice.title: Placet Group — Unified Self-Service
placetSelfservice.description: Unified self-service platform for multiple brands: loans, cards, documents, support.
placetSelfservice.listDescription: Unified self-service platform enabling users to manage loans, cards, and documents in one account across multiple brands.
placetSelfservice.challenge:
Users managed different financial products — loans, credit line, cards, and documents — through fragmented interfaces and scenarios.
The lack of a unified environment increased cognitive load, complicated navigation, and made it harder to understand the overall financial picture.
placetSelfservice.solution:
I designed a unified self-service platform that brings all user products and actions into a single, coherent interface.
Key decisions included:
• a unified overview of all financial products and states,
• consistent navigation across scenarios,
• reusable UX patterns for actions and statuses,
• a scalable structure for future products and features.
placetSelfservice.result: The unified self-service platform simplified product management and reduced cognitive load. Users navigate the system faster, experience fewer breaks between scenarios, and complete key actions with greater confidence.

impact.label: Self-service usage +23%
impact.description: A single account and clear statuses reduced context switching — users complete tasks on their own.

impact.label: Support tickets −26%
impact.description: Transparent request and product statuses reduced uncertainty — fewer users contact support.

impact.label: Key flows 2.4× faster
impact.description: Navigation and actions became predictable — users find what they need and finish flows faster.
